The role index lists `mastermind` as "architect (Sonnet, high)". The tier is resolved in `tiers.js`, so this is today's value and the readme says so. It will go stale when the tier changes.
One old pointer to the CLAUDE.md wording is left in a dated record (`ai/sessions/2026/09/19/system-eval/skills.md`). It is history, so leaving it is fine.
